items.title: Fortaleza (CE) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 1 #007/2025
items.en_title: Fortaleza (CE) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 1 #007/2025
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Fortaleza (CE) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 2,500,000; proposals close Dec 1, 10:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
